name: segmented-path-materials
landmark: Multi-phase flight path over Lake Michigan
perspective: regional overhead view showing a sampled color transition
description: Exercise CesiumJS 1.143 PathGraphics.materialMode with the sampled-material branch by rendering one time-dynamic route whose color transitions from cyan through lime to orange. The scene must use PathMode.PORTIONS, a SampledProperty of Color values, bounded lead/trail times, and a practical positive resolution.
prompt: Create a public no-token Viewer with an explicit OpenStreetMap base layer and EllipsoidTerrainProvider. Build a SampledPositionProperty for a four-minute flight over Lake Michigan from 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z through 12:04:00Z, with samples every 60 seconds from approximately (-88.0, 41.7, 12000) to (-87.0, 42.0, 12000). Build a SampledProperty(Cesium.Color) with exactly three samples: Cesium.Color.CYAN at start, Cesium.Color.LIME at 12:02, and Cesium.Color.ORANGE at stop, then wrap it in a ColorMaterialProperty. Add one entity whose path uses that sampled material, materialMode: Cesium.PathMode.PORTIONS, resolution: 30, leadTime: 120, trailTime: 120, and width: 8. Set the Viewer clock start/stop/current times, place currentTime at 12:02:00Z, use ClockRange.CLAMPED, keep shouldAnimate false, and tick once. Frame the complete route with Rectangle.fromDegrees(-88.15, 41.55, -86.85, 42.15) so the sampled color transition is plainly visible. Do not emulate segmentation with multiple entities or polylines.
expected_behaviors: Constructs a SampledPositionProperty spanning a non-zero four-minute interval
Constructs a SampledProperty of Color values with three samples over the route interval
Wraps the sampled cyan, lime, and orange values in one ColorMaterialProperty
Uses a positive path resolution of roughly 30 seconds with bounded leadTime and trailTime
Uses one entity/path rather than manually splitting the route into multiple entities
Sets the clock currentTime at the middle color sample and ticks once
Frames the entire Lake Michigan route so the sampled material transition is visible
visual_expectations: A regional overhead view with one continuous flight path visibly transitioning from cyan through lime to orange, with the complete sampled-material route in frame.

programmatic_checks.description: Wraps sampled colors as one material
Uses cyan at the route start
Uses orange at the route stop
Uses a positive bounded segmentation resolution

screenshots.description: One route with a cyan-to-lime-to-orange sampled transition
